$extensions.aesthetic: precision dark interface — keyboard-first, sub-100ms, purple accent glow

surface.$description: Cod Gray — deepest background, inbox canvas, the void emails float above

surface-raised.$description: Raised surface — email list pane, sidebar panels

surface-elevated.$description: Elevated surface — selected email thread, compose window, modals

surface-overlay.$description: Overlay surface — command palette (Cmd+K), dropdown menus, popovers

surface-highest.$description: Highest elevation — tooltips, toast notifications, topmost layer

accent.$description: Superhuman Purple — primary interactive accent, focused states, CTA

accent-hover.$description: Purple hover — lightened for hover/focus feedback

accent-subtle.$description: Purple wash — selected row background, active state tint

accent-glow.$description: Purple glow — focus ring outer glow, keyboard-focused element halo

text-primary.$description: Pure white — sender names, subjects, headings, high-signal text

text-secondary.$description: White at 65% — email previews, body text, timestamps (per Superhuman's dark theme research)

text-tertiary.$description: White at 40% — placeholder text, disabled labels, metadata

text-on-accent.$description: White on purple — button labels, badge text on accent

error.$description: Error red — validation, failed sends, destructive actions

error-subtle.$description: Error background tint — error banner backgrounds

success.$description: Success green — sent confirmation, inbox zero celebration

success-subtle.$description: Success background tint — success banner backgrounds

warning.$description: Warning amber — snooze indicators, remind-me badges

info.$description: Info blue — read receipts, link highlights, informational badges

border-subtle.$description: Barely visible divider — email row separators, panel edges

border-default.$description: Standard border — card outlines, input fields, section dividers

border-strong.$description: Prominent border — focused input outlines, active panel edges

focus-ring.$description: Double-ring keyboard focus — dark gap + purple ring for WCAG visibility on dark

font-display.$description: System sans — zero FOUT, sub-100ms render, matches OS native feel

font-body.$description: Same system stack — unified, no font network requests

font-mono.$description: Monospace — keyboard shortcut hints, code snippets in emails

scale-display.$description: Display — onboarding headlines, marketing moments (rare in-app)

scale-section.$description: Section — settings page headers, split inbox category titles

scale-title.$description: Title — email subject in thread view, compose subject line

scale-base.$description: Base — email body, compose text, primary reading size (optimized for email)

scale-small.$description: Small — inbox row preview text, sidebar labels, timestamps

scale-caption.$description: Caption — keyboard shortcut hints, status indicators, badge text

line-height-tight.$description: Tight — headings, subject lines, single-line labels

line-height-normal.$description: Normal — email body text, compose area

line-height-relaxed.$description: Relaxed — long-form email reading, marketing copy

weight-regular.$description: Regular — body text, email content, secondary labels

weight-medium.$description: Medium — unread sender names, active nav items, button labels

weight-semibold.$description: Semibold — section headings, keyboard shortcut keys, emphasis

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tight tracking — display and section headings

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide tracking — all-caps labels, keyboard hint text

unit.$description: Base unit — Superhuman uses a tight 4px grid for density

2xs.$description: Hairline — icon-to-label gaps, inline badge padding

xs.$description: Extra small — tight internal padding, chip gaps

sm.$description: Small — inbox row horizontal padding, list item gaps

md.$description: Medium — card padding, input padding, button padding

lg.$description: Large — section internal padding, compose area margins

xl.$description: Extra large — panel padding, modal content padding

2xl.$description: Double XL — section gaps, major layout spacing

inbox-row-height.$description: Inbox row height — optimized for scan speed, fits sender + subject + preview

thread-max-width.$description: Thread reading width — optimal for email body readability

container-max.$description: Max container — full desktop layout width

radius-none.$description: None — inbox rows, list items (sharp edges for speed/density)

radius-sm.$description: Small — inline badges, chips, keyboard shortcut keys

radius-xl.$description: Extra large — command palette, onboarding panels

radius-pill.$description: Pill — status badges, avatar containers, toggle switches

level-0.$description: Flat — inbox rows, list items (no shadow, elevation via bg color)

level-1.$description: Subtle — raised panels, sidebar edge shadow

level-2.$description: Elevated — compose window, modals, command palette

level-3.$description: Dramatic — command palette overlay, critical modals

glow-focus.$description: Focus glow — purple ring + soft glow on keyboard-focused elements

duration-instant.$description: Instant — keyboard shortcut feedback, row selection highlight

duration-fast.$description: Fast — hover states, focus rings, micro-interactions

duration-smooth.$description: Smooth — compose window expand, modal enter/exit

easing-snap.$description: Snap — fast-in, no bounce, instant feel for keyboard actions

easing-smooth.$description: Smooth — natural deceleration for panels and modals

easing-spring.$description: Spring — subtle overshoot for celebratory moments (inbox zero)

reduced-duration.$description: Near-zero duration for prefers-reduced-motion. Applied via media query.

reduced-easing.$description: Linear easing for reduced motion -- no spring/bounce.

wide.$description: Wide — three-pane layout, sidebar + list + thread
